text: Ɓen haɓooɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe bonnira jaggitere warugol e jaɓugol jawle e sakkagol ka ɗate, battane maɓɓe wonaali si wanaa ko yo ɓe ware tun, maa ɓe wariree dummbeede, maa taƴugol senngo ñaamo ngon ka juuɗe maɓɓe e ka koyɗe maɓɓe luutindra, si ontigi fillitike, senngo nano ngon ka juuɗe e ka koyɗe kadi taƴee, maa ɓe riiwee e leydi ndin. Ɗen lepte maɓɓe, wonanii ɓe wirtere aduna, hino woodani ɓe kadi laakara lepte mawɗe.
